record.paper_title: PURE O-SEQUENCES: KNOWN RESULTS, APPLICATIONS AND OPEN PROBLEMS
record.original_question: Is every pure O-sequence of type 2 unimodal in arbitrary codimension? More generally, for each fixed codimension, which socle types force unimodality of all pure O-sequences in that codimension?

evidence.quote: A natural question is whether all pure O-sequences of type 2 and arbitrary codimension are unimodal. Also, for any fixed codimension, it is an interesting problem to determine which types force unimodality.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Definitions. Let r be a positive integer and let X be a finite, nonempty set of monomials in the variables y_1,...,y_r over a field. The set X is called a pure order ideal (or pure multicomplex) if (i) whenever m ∈ X and m' divides m, then m' ∈ X, and (ii) all maximal elements of X (under divisibility) have the same total degree e. The pure O-sequence associated with X is the vector h = (h_0, h_1, ..., h_e) where h_i is the number of monomials of degree i in X; in particular h_0 = 1 and h_1 ≤ r. The integer e is the socle degree and t := h_e is called the type. The codimension of h is h_1. A finite sequence (h_0,...,h_e) of positive integers is called unimodal if there exists an index j with h_0 ≤ h_1 ≤ ... ≤ h_j ≥ h_{j+1} ≥ ... ≥ h_e.

Question. (a) Is every pure O-sequence of type 2 unimodal, in every codimension r ≥ 1? That is, if X is a pure order ideal in r variables having exactly two maximal monomials, must its associated h-vector be unimodal?

(b) More generally, for each fixed codimension r, determine the set of types t for which every pure O-sequence of codimension r and type t is forced to be unimodal.
artifact.status_search_result: The unimodality of pure O-sequences of type 2 in codimension 3 was established (via the Weak Lefschetz Property) by Boij–Migliore–Miró-Roig–Nagel–Zanello. Subsequent work (e.g., on type-three sequences and on non-unimodal level h-vectors) has produced non-unimodal pure O-sequences for sufficiently large type/codimension, but no published resolution of the type-2 case in codimensions r ≥ 4, nor a complete classification of socle types forcing unimodality in each fixed codimension, was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the shape of a pure O-sequence
status_evidence.snippet: Proves WLP in codimension 3 and as a corollary that pure O-sequences of codimension 3 and type 2 are unimodal over any field; raises higher-codimension type-2 case as open.
status_evidence.claim: Type-2 unimodality is established in codimension 3, leaving higher codimensions open.

status_evidence.title: The unimodality of pure O-sequences of type three in codimension three
status_evidence.snippet: Studies unimodality for type 3 in codimension 3, indicating the broader fixed-codimension classification is still being investigated.
status_evidence.claim: Related fixed-codimension unimodality questions are subjects of ongoing research.

status_evidence.title: Pure O-Sequences: Known Results, Applications, and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as natural open problems whether all pure O-sequences of type 2 in arbitrary codimension are unimodal, and which types force unimodality for each fixed codimension.
status_evidence.claim: The questions are explicitly stated as open problems in this expository survey.
